review_candidates.title: IT Infrastructure & Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Firewalls and Security: End-to-end security in keeping the network secure and maintaining firewalls within the network. Strong grasp of Microsoft Active Directory administration, troubleshooting issues in DNS in a connected environment. Strong ability to troubleshoot Microsoft Office 365, Exchange Online email deliverability issues, and anti-spam solutions Experience supporting conferencing and video conferencing solutions; Skype for Business, Zoom, Cisco WebEx, Microsoft Teams.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: At least 5-10 years full-time professional experience supporting network, server, storage, and IT security. Proficiency with shared storage technologies (NAS), Microsoft operating systems, Structured Query Language (SQL) Ability to support and resolve a wide range of daily technical issues; eagerness to investigate and learn new technologies Strong ability and emphasis on automation where applicable; provisioning and patching of endpoints Strong attention to detail, documentation, communication skills, and follow-through Graduate Engineer with CCNA/CCNP, Microsoft Technology Associate (MTA) Certifications preferred.

review_candidates.title: Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities: Perform routine system and network checks, proactively identifying and resolving issues. Support and maintain firewalls, switches, and Internet connectivity (Palo Alto / Juniper). Maintain and monitor hybrid cloud and on-prem infrastructure, ensuring uptime and resilience.
eligibility_evidence: Infrastructure Engineer | £85,000 - £110,000 | Hybrid (in x4) | Financial We are working with a Private Investment Firm who are looking for an Infrastructure Engineer to join their close-knit IT Team.
Maintain and monitor hybrid cloud and on-prem infrastructure, ensuring uptime and resilience.
Core Skills & Experience: Proven background in network and infrastructure engineering across hybrid environments.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on technical role that will see you managing critical network infrastructure, cloud connectivity, and firewall systems for a demanding business landscape. Hands-on experience with Juniper or Cisco switches and Palo Alto firewalls. Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and familiarity with Terraform for IaC.
